name: The Ethereal Dream ~Qi Ye zhi Meng~
source:
Set against the backdrop of the 18th century, the story unfolds around a novice nun who encounters and interacts with some departed souls.

[From [url=https://kamotonegi.itch.io/ted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事以18世纪为背景，围绕一位新手修女与一些逝去的灵魂相遇并互动展开。

[来自[url=https://kamotonegi.itch.io/ted]Itch.io[/url]]
